name: burgundysuite
description: Burgundy Suite & Resort — Nuxt 3 (Frontend) + Nest.js (Backend) Monorepo with Cloudflare D1 & R2

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "magenta,cyan" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
